app.name: VI 720p test (experimental)
app.short_description: Draws a test pattern at 74.25 MHz 720p-rate timing
app.long_description: EXPERIMENTAL. Shows a bold test pattern first in the proven 1280x240p 54 MHz mode, then attempts a 720p-rate raster at the confirmed 74.25 MHz VI clock, measuring the real line/field rate and total lines and logging to vi720.txt on USB (and SD). The display may roll, offset, or stay black; the measurements say how close the timing is. PLL and VI are restored at the end and all registers reset on reboot. HOME/Start advances or exits.
